scored_leaves.name: Founder-problem expertise
scored_leaves.rubric: 1 no public evidence of domain experience; 2 adjacent field or under 3 years; 3 at least 3 years in the target industry or its research field; 4 recognised expert (doctorate plus 5 years, or senior operating role in the industry); 5 the founder's own work is the basis of the core product, plus commercial experience in the target industry.

scored_leaves.name: Team completeness
scored_leaves.rubric: Technical, commercial and domain/regulatory leads, each a named person: 1 one; 2 two; 3 all three, one part-time or advisory; 4 all three full-time; 5 plus named leads for the next stage's main function.

scored_leaves.name: Prior venture or operating track record
labels: Senior role at scale or funded venture
scored_leaves.rubric: 1 none public; 2 prior venture with no known outcome, or 5+ years operating; 3 senior role in a company of 100+ staff, or a prior venture that raised outside capital; 4 a prior venture with a known exit, or executive of a scaled company; 5 two or more at 4.

scored_leaves.name: Advisors, board and key hires
scored_leaves.rubric: 1 none named; 2 named without relevant domain or investor experience; 3 an independent chair or one relevant domain advisor; 4 sector and investor directors; 5 level 4 plus a named senior hire from a leading firm in the target industry.

scored_leaves.name: Problem severity and willingness to pay
labels: Customers already pay for a substitute
scored_leaves.rubric: 1 stated only by the company; 2 an independent source confirms it; 3 an independent source quantifies its cost or impact; 4 plus a named budget holder or obligation; 5 plus evidence that customers already pay for an inferior substitute.

scored_leaves.name: Differentiation and defensibility
scored_leaves.rubric: 1 none stated; 2 differentiation claimed, no protectable asset; 3 filed patent, exclusive licence or proprietary dataset; 4 granted patent or exclusive licence in a major market; 5 plus a publicly evidenced compounding advantage.

scored_leaves.name: Product or technology readiness
scored_leaves.rubric: Concept, prototype, pilot-ready (in pilots or trials), commercial (sold and delivered).

scored_leaves.name: Regulatory and certification burden (minimise)
labels: Approved in one market or certification only
scored_leaves.rubric: Worst to best: approval required and not started; required and under way; obtained in one major market or certification only; no product approval required.

scored_leaves.name: Addressable market size
scored_leaves.rubric: US$ bn, 2025, the median of distinct publishers' public estimates for the narrowest named segment containing the core product.

scored_leaves.name: Market growth
scored_leaves.rubric: % CAGR, the median of the same publishers' stated forecast CAGRs.

scored_leaves.name: Competitive intensity (minimise)
scored_leaves.rubric: A funded leader is a direct competitor with US$10m+ disclosed funding or a public listing: three or more; one or two; direct competitors below that; none identified.

scored_leaves.name: Route to global markets
scored_leaves.rubric: Access, not customers: 1 none stated; 2 target markets named; 3 offshore approval, accreditation or channel process under way; 4 obtained, or an offshore entity; 5 operating in two or more offshore markets with local staff.

scored_leaves.name: Customer validation
scored_leaves.rubric: The strongest independently verifiable customer evidence.

scored_leaves.name: Commercial stage
scored_leaves.rubric: Breadth and repeatability of revenue: none; first; multiple recurring customers; stated growth with revenue in several markets.

scored_leaves.name: Strategic partnerships and channels
labels: Commercial agreement with an established firm
scored_leaves.rubric: Non-customer partners: 1 none; 2 MoU or research collaboration; 3 a named partner in an active programme; 4 a commercial, distribution or manufacturing agreement with an established firm; 5 two or more at 4.

scored_leaves.name: Milestone delivery
labels: Two or more delivered on plan
scored_leaves.rubric: Earlier public plans compared with later outcomes.
